closureKeyRule: sha256 of RFC 8785 (JCS) bytes of {contractDigest,disposition,evidenceDigest,phaseId,projectId,reasonCode,runId}; no trailing newline; reasonCode null when absent
manifestRule: manifest bytes are canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact, printable ASCII, string values only) with no trailing newline; the file adds exactly one newline and ssh-keygen -Y sign covers manifest + newline; manifestSha256 covers the manifest bytes without the newline
